name: KAISER 5X

specs.notes: 575 PS (423 kW, 567 hp) at 6,000 rpm, 750 N m from 2,200 to 5,000, 0-100 km/h in 4.2 s, 250 km/h limited, 2,275 kg DIN kerb (2,350 EU), 2,933 mm wheelbase. ZF 8HP ratios (5.0 ... 0.64), 3.15 final; xDrive rear-biased (40 % front used).

garage.blurb: The first SUV BMW's M division built from scratch. Sharp steering and a twin-turbo V8 in a tall, heavy body: quicker than it has any right to be, until physics catches up.

interior.notes: The model's M interior mesh (diffuse, normal and material maps); steering wheel cut out to turn, lever animated.
